J&J's gross margin in fiscal Q3 2024 was about 69.0%. I took the figures from its Q3 2024 earnings release.

- Sales to customers were $22,471 million.
- Cost of products sold was $6,963 million, which is 31.0% of sales.
- Gross profit was therefore $22,471 − $6,963 = $15,508 million.
- Gross margin is $15,508 ÷ $22,471, which is about 69.0%.
